# BubbleHub v0.2.0

BubbleHub v0.2.0 expands the local agent runtime with a rebranded CLI, a desktop Control Center, Windows installer support, and stronger sandbox policy controls.

## ✨ New Features

* Added the `bubble` CLI, BubbleHub desktop app, and `libbubble` native library names as part of the BubbleHub rebrand.
* Added the BubbleHub Control Center for graphical monitoring, model selection, running-agent visibility, and sandbox access-manifest review.
* Added native Windows installation paths, including a PowerShell installer and `.exe` bootstrapper that install BubbleHub through WSL and create Control Center shortcuts.
* Added persistent Ubuntu-based sandboxes with per-agent overlay filesystems so agent homes and setup work can survive across runs.
* Added sandbox network policy manifests, host approval prompts, and an HTTP proxy path for controlled outbound access.
* Added local GPU serving, improved base-model selection, dynamic manifests, and backend hosting through `libbubble`.

## ⚡ Improvements

* Improved release automation with tag-driven release publishing, release-note handoff, Linux package smoke tests, Windows installer smoke tests, and Docker image validation.
* Improved Docker and release documentation with getting-started guides, agent-running guides, runtime architecture notes, and interactive Docker development instructions.
* Improved test coverage across Python and `libbubble`, including Codecov reporting, C unit tests, warm model reuse coverage, and Windows release-install smoke coverage.
* Improved CI with Python and C linting, pre-commit enforcement, Windows runner fixes, coverage artifacts, and clearer contributor validation steps.
* Improved GitHub project hygiene with issue templates, a pull request template, maintainer issue forms, and updated PR preparation guidance.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fixed packaged inference startup when BubbleHub is installed and launched from Windows through WSL.
* Fixed Windows CI and self-hosted Windows runner behavior for release installer validation.
* Fixed sandbox startup issues around shell prompts, nested sandbox CLI use, sandbox path logging, and `.bashrc` handling.
* Fixed sandboxed Python prompt/shim behavior so agents inside the sandbox use the forwarded inference endpoint instead of trying to load native inference directly.
* Fixed Discord release and feature announcement payload issues.

## 🔒 Security & Sandboxing

* Hardened sandbox isolation with persistent Ubuntu overlay filesystems and clearer separation between agent workspaces and system state.
* Improved network isolation by defaulting sandboxed agents to local inference access and requiring explicit policy for general outbound HTTP or HTTPS access.
* Added manifest-based access review so pending sandbox network requests can be inspected and resolved from the dashboard or CLI.
* Added more `libbubble` unit and integration coverage around sandbox execution, scheduler behavior, and repeated native chat reuse.

## 🚀 Installation

Latest release asset base:
```text
https://BubbleHub.ai/download/latest
```

Specific release asset base:
```text
https://BubbleHub.ai/download/v0.2.0
```

Linux curl installer:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://BubbleHub.ai/install.sh | bash
```

Linux Debian package:
```bash
curl -LO https://BubbleHub.ai/download/latest/BubbleHub-0.2.0-x64.deb
sudo apt install ./BubbleHub-0.2.0-x64.deb
```

Open the BubbleHub desktop app after installing:
```bash
bubblehub
```

Windows PowerShell installer:
```powershell
irm https://BubbleHub.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

The Windows installers check for WSL/Ubuntu, install the released Debian package into WSL, and create BubbleHub Control Center Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts that launch the desktop app.

Windows `.exe` bootstrapper:
```powershell
irm https://BubbleHub.ai/download/latest/BubbleHub-0.2.0-x64.exe -OutFile BubbleHub-0.2.0-x64.exe
.\BubbleHub-0.2.0-x64.exe
```
